title: Confirmation statement (CS01)
text:
This form confirms that your company’s details are up to date on the Companies House register. It costs £110 to file your confirmation statement on paper.

 It’s quicker, easier and costs less to file your confirmation statement online .

 Changes to your company information

 Use parts 1 to 4 to make changes to the company’s:

 • principal business activities or standard industrial classification (SIC)

 • statement of capital

 • trading status of shares and exemption from providing people with significant control (PSC) information

 • shareholder information

 Registered email address

 You must use part 5 to provide a registered email address if you have not already provided one.

 There’s a different process if you need to  change your company’s registered email address .

 Identity verification

 You must give the identity verification details for all your current directors, 
unless you have already provided this information. See Verifying your identity for Companies House .

 Standard industrial classification (SIC) codes

 Use the condensed list of SIC codes if you need to update your nature of business activity on your confirmation statement.

 Restoring a company

 If you’re restoring a company to the register, you must put the confirmation date that was due before it was struck off.

 If you’re not sure of the correct date, contact Companies House before completing your form.

 Continuation pages

 The continuation pages are optional. Only use them if you need to provide more details.

 Forms must be printed at full size on white A4 sized paper.
